name: Bourns-3314
title: 3314: 4 mm square single-turn cermet SMD trimming potentiometer, 10 Ω to 2 MΩ
summary: A sealed, single-turn cermet trimmer in a 4 mm square body, adjusted with a screwdriver slot. Standard values run from 10 Ω to 2 MΩ at ±20 %, rated 0.25 W at 70 °C over -55 °C to +125 °C, with a ±100 ppm/°C temperature coefficient. It comes with J-hook, gull-wing, through-hole pin or edge-terminal styles, single or cross slot, and is AEC-Q200 Grade 1 qualified.

operation.text: A sealed single-turn trimmer with a cermet element, 4 mm square in body. The rotor turns through 240° nominal between its stops and the adjustment angle is 210° nominal. It is set with a screwdriver slot, straight or cross, and the H-90 is the matching adjustment tool. Turning clockwise moves the wiper (terminal 2) toward terminal 3.

The series comes in six styles: J has J-hook terminals folded under the body, G has gull-wing terminals, H has straight pins for through-hole boards, R has formed terminals and a land pattern with a 3.2 mm hole under the rotor, R-GM5 is the R with a longer lead frame and a cross slot, and S and Z carry all three terminals along one edge. The 300 V limit applies to J, G and H and the 50 V limit to R.
Rated 0.25 W at 70 °C, falling to 0 W at 125 °C, over a -55 °C to +125 °C range, with a temperature coefficient of ±100 ppm/°C.
The wiper is set to 50 % of total resistance ±10 % when shipped. On the S and Z styles the rotor sits within ±22° of the terminal 2 centreline.

Suited to surface-mount assembly and to common vacuum pick-and-place equipment; RoHS compliant and AEC-Q200 Grade 1 qualified; it meets the EIA/EIAJ/IPC/VECI standard for SMD trimmers. Reeled parts are MSL-1. Store at no more than 40 °C and 70 % relative humidity.
